Escolha Desligado na aba Filtros para nã: Choose Off in the Filters tab to apply no LUT.

Em Configurações → Captura e arquivos →: In Settings → Capture and files → Photographic Styles, Editing in Apple Photos creates a HEIF with editable styles. Enabling it returns the processed format to HEIF; it requires the native iOS module. Choosing JPEG in File format turns this preference off.
Live Photo pausa essa opção. Retrato, Im: Live Photo pauses this option. Portrait, Image Stacking and HEIF+ can apply styles to HEIF output; both Bayer RAW and ProRAW apply styles only to the selected processed companion or derivative. The DNG remains unchanged and receives no styles. This preference does not prove that every lens and Photos version will support editing: check the saved file on your device before relying on this pipeline.
O texto de ajuda do ajuste ainda mencion: The setting's help text still mentions standard RAW as unavailable. In the reviewed version, capture policy allows styles on the Bayer HEIF derivative; suspension still applies to Live Photo.
Aba Grão com as opções Desligado, Suave,: Grain tab with Off, Soft, Medium and Strong options; Medium is selected.

Aba Halation com Desligado selecionado e: Halation tab with Off selected and Soft, Medium and Strong options.
A intensidade do halation é escolhida se: Halation intensity is chosen separately from grain and filters.
Grão e halation foram recalibrados e ago: Grain and halation have been recalibrated and now offer three direct intensities: Soft, Medium and Strong. Grain simulates photographic texture; halation creates a diffuse reddish halo around highlights with local contrast.
Escolha Desligado na aba Grão ou Halatio: Choose Off in the Grain or Halation tab to turn off each effect.
LUT, grão e halation podem ser combinado: LUT, grain and halation can be combined in the same processing pass.
Ative a cópia original para salvar també: Enable the original copy option to also save a version without LUTs and effects when the pipeline allows it.

Localização no EXIF para usar o mapa: Location in EXIF to use the map
Internet para carregar o mapa e o serviç: Internet to load maps and the EXIF Frame service
Sem projeto ativo, as fotos são salvas n: Without an active project, photos are saved in the Komorebi album. Projects use albums prefixed with Komorebi followed by the chosen name. The app reconciles the local project list with available albums.
Crie um projeto nas configurações ou no: Create a project in settings or the corresponding selector.
Selecione o projeto antes de fotografar: Select the project before shooting to direct new captures to it.
Mover ou excluir projetos altera a organ: Moving or deleting projects changes local organization; confirm the effect on photos before completing the action.
A galeria lê metadados técnicos, exibe b: The gallery reads technical metadata, displays Komorebi badges and shows a photo full screen. When an image contains coordinates, the map loads OpenStreetMap tiles centered on that location, using Leaflet in the WebView.
Confira e remova GPS antes de compartilh: Check and remove GPS before sharing sensitive images.
A exclusão ocorre somente após uma ação: Deletion only happens after an action you take.
Metadados podem variar conforme o format: Metadata may vary by format and operating system.
Abra uma foto e toque em … para acessar: Open a photo and tap … to access Actions: sharing, rating from 0 to 5 stars and depth. Information contains EXIF and location; only one panel stays open at a time.
Na grade, toque em Selecionar ou mantenh: In the grid, tap Select or press and hold a thumbnail. Mark photos to Rate, Share or Delete. Changing projects or leaving ends the selection.
Avaliar aplica a mesma nota ao lote. A e: Rating applies the same score to the batch. The crossed-out star removes the rating; canceling keeps saved scores and leaves pending items selected.
Compartilhar abre uma folha nativa para: Sharing opens a native sheet for all prepared images. On iOS, it exports the current representation, including edits; Live Photos are shared as still images. Files stored only in iCloud may need downloading.
Se uma imagem não puder ser preparada, o: If an image cannot be prepared, the batch is not partially shared.
Apagar exige confirmação e remove as fot: Deleting requires confirmation and removes photos from the library and all albums, including outside the active project.
Profundidade é uma ação individual e não: Depth is an individual action and does not appear in batch actions.
Gere profundidade na original ou em uma: Generate depth on the original or a copy
O gerador abre um serviço externo em Web: The generator opens an external service in a WebView. When using it, the image and metadata may be sent to or injected into the site to build the frame. Do not use sensitive photos without reviewing the displayed data.
Gere profundidade local em fotos elegíve: Generate local depth for eligible photos on iOS and choose between the original and a copy.
iOS com o módulo nativo instalado: iOS with the native module installed
Fotos com leitura e escrita autorizadas: Photos read and write permissions granted
JPEG/HEIC elegível sem profundidade exis: Eligible JPEG/HEIC without existing depth; RAW is not accepted
Abra uma foto, toque em … e consulte a a: Open a photo, tap … and check the depth action. The DepthAnythingV2SmallF16 model is bundled with the app and runs locally, without a first-use download or sending the photo to a server. Android does not offer this action.
Esse recurso estima profundidade relativ: This feature estimates relative depth after capture and is separate from the camera's Portrait mode. It does not measure physical distances. Eligible Live Photos keep their video in the edit or copy.
Aplicar profundidade na original mantém: Applying depth to the original keeps the library item and creates a reversible edit with a private backup. The Portrait adjustment is accessed through Edit in Photos.
Criar uma cópia salva um novo original c: Creating a copy saves a new original with depth and preserves the source photo. The copy receives compatible date, location, favorite, visibility, rating and album information.
A cópia permite a alternância de Retrato: The copy allows the Portrait toggle in the viewer in cases already tested. Broader compatibility with Photos controls remains experimental and depends on the file, device and iOS.
HEIF com Estilos Fotográficos exige cópi: HEIF with Photographic Styles requires a copy when EXIF orientation is not 1 or when it is a Live Photo; the interface prevents editing the original in these cases.
Reverter profundidade depende do backup: Reverting depth depends on the private backup and an edit recognized as belonging to Komorebi. Later edits in another app may block reversal to preserve that change.
Fotos editadas pela versão anterior pode: Photos edited by the previous version may offer Save copy for Portrait from the backup. Uninstalling the app removes private backups; the source photo preserved by creating a copy remains in the library.
Consulte o efeito, a persistência e as d: Check the effect, persistence and dependencies of Komorebi preferences.
As preferências são mantidas localmente: Preferences are stored locally with AsyncStorage
No início de Configurações, um card de t: At the top of Settings, a tutorial card opens a guide from this documentation in the device browser. The guide varies between camera, effects, projects and, on iOS, RAW and manual controls. Viewing it uses internet; opening a guide does not send a photo.
Controles inferiores com seletor EV e IS: Lower controls with EV and ISO selector, exposure scale, yellow shutter and lenses from 0.5 to 8.

Configurações → Câmera reúne as guias e: Settings → Camera contains guides and viewfinder appearance. Settings → Effects preview controls LUT, Halation and Grain in the live image; on iOS, also Double Exposure and Stacking previews. The saved result uses high-resolution processing and may differ from the preview.
Estilo retrô: altera a apresentação do v: Retro style: changes viewfinder presentation. When off, the interface uses soft preview edges; this appearance does not change the saved photo.
Histograma: mostra a distribuição de lum: Histogram: shows live luminance distribution when the active pipeline supports it.
Indicador de altas luzes e Indicador de: Highlight indicator and Shadow indicator: mark exposure extremes in the iOS preview.
Som do obturador: ativa ou desativa o so: Shutter sound: enables or disables the app's own sound without overriding system rules.
Controles na parte inferior: coloca a To: Controls at the bottom: places the TopBar below the preview.
No iOS, você pode baixar ou remover o mo: On iOS, you can download or remove the MiniCPM-V model used by the Composition Scanner. The download takes up about 1.6 GB, stays on the device and is optional: without it, Scan continues with basic system analysis. Smart tags and descriptive names are independent options, off by default, and require a ready model.

Salvar localização: grava GPS apenas em: Save location: writes GPS only to new photos and only with permission.
O formato é escolhido no atalho Formato: Format is selected in the TopBar File format shortcut. Capture and files contains copy without effects, authorship, location, Photographic Styles and HEIF+ Development settings on iOS.
Autoria: grava autor e direitos autorais: Authorship: writes author and copyright to future captures without changing existing photos.

Pauses during Live Photo; Bayer RAW and ProRAW apply styles only to the selected processed companion or derivative, without changing the DNG.

Em Sobre → Compartilhar diagnósticos, de: In About → Share diagnostics, turn technical reporting to Sentry off or on. It starts enabled; turning it off ends monitoring in the current session and prevents it from starting on the next launch. This does not delete previously sent events.
Em Barra de controles, escolha até oito: In Control bar, choose up to eight shortcuts and set their order; Settings remains available and cannot be removed. Position is changed in Camera → Controls at the bottom. Incompatible options remain subject to lens capabilities, operating system and permissions.

Use um dispositivo físico para testar câ: Use a physical device to test camera, library, GPS, sensors, RAW, Live Photo, portrait, volume buttons and Camera Control. Simulators do not reproduce all capabilities or final processing.
iOS e câmera com os controles manuais an: iOS and a camera reporting available manual controls

Ative Controles manuais na TopBar. O pai: Enable Manual controls in the TopBar. The lower panel replaces the exposure scale in the same space and offers EV, ISO, SS (shutter speed), WB (white balance) and AF (focus). Select a setting on the left and drag the scale on the right to change its value.
AUTO indica que aquele controle está aut: AUTO indicates that a control is automatic. A brief tap on the scale returns ISO, SS, WB or AF to automatic; for EV, tapping returns to 0.0 EV. Leaving manual mode restores automatic settings; reopening the panel starts at EV.
Painel inferior com ISO, SS e WB; SS sel: Lower panel with ISO, SS and WB; SS selected, scale marked AUTO and lens 4 active.
No painel manual, SS seleciona a velocid: In the manual panel, SS selects shutter speed; AUTO indicates automatic adjustment.
ISO amplifica o sinal: valores maiores a: ISO amplifies the signal: higher values help in low light but may increase noise. A slower shutter gathers light for longer and increases the risk of camera shake and motion blur. A fast shutter helps freeze the subject, requiring more light or higher ISO.
A compensação EV orienta a exposição aut: EV compensation guides automatic exposure. It is not the same as changing the lens's physical aperture. When ISO and time are fixed, check the actual effect in the preview and file.
Comece no automático e altere uma variáv: Start in automatic mode and change one variable at a time.
Para assuntos em movimento, priorize vel: For moving subjects, prioritize shutter speed; for a still scene with support, try a longer exposure.
Se altas luzes importantes estourarem, r: If important highlights clip, reduce exposure; recovering detail later is not guaranteed.
Toque no assunto para definir o ponto de: Tap the subject to set the focus point when supported. Manual focus controls lens position; its value is not a distance in meters.
O balanço de branco modifica a aparência: White balance changes the appearance of temperature and tint. Keeping it stable helps compare photos of the same scene. Availability and limits come from the active camera.
O histograma mostra a distribuição de lu: The histogram shows luminance distribution; concentrations at the extremes call for attention to shadows and highlights. Zebra marks extreme regions in the preview. These aids are not recorded in the image.
Preview, efeitos e processamento do sist: Preview, effects and system processing may cause differences in the saved result. Check the final image, especially in RAW/HEIF+.
iOS e lente com RAW para DNG ou pares RA: iOS and a RAW-capable lens for DNG or RAW pairs
Menu Formato de arquivo com RAW Nenhum,: File format menu with RAW None, ProRAW and Bayer RAW, and processed photo None, HEIF, HEIF+ and JPEG; HEIF is selected.
The selector separates RAW and processed photo. In this example, only HEIF output is active.
Na TopBar, abra Formato de arquivo. A ár: Open File format in the TopBar. The RAW area offers None and the ProRAW and Bayer RAW modes available on the lens; Processed photo offers None and HEIF, HEIF+ or JPEG on iOS. On Android, processed output is JPEG. If the shortcut is missing, add it in Settings → Control bar.
Mantenha pelo menos uma saída. Para salv: Keep at least one output. To save only DNG, select a RAW mode, then None in Processed photo. To save only HEIF/JPEG, select the processed photo, then None in RAW. The selector does not allow turning off the last output.
HEIF: foto processada com armazenamento: HEIF: processed photo with efficient storage; confirm that the destination accepts .heic.
JPEG: opção para aplicativos e serviços: JPEG: an option for apps and services that need wider compatibility.
HEIF+: foto revelada a partir de DNG no: HEIF+: a photo developed from DNG in Komorebi's native pipeline.
RAW sozinho: salva somente DNG, com RAW: RAW alone: saves only DNG, using Bayer RAW or ProRAW depending on the lens.
RAW + foto processada: salva um único it: RAW + processed photo: saves one library item with two original resources, DNG and HEIC/JPEG.
ProRAW and Bayer RAW are separate options. The app checks support on the active rear camera and shows each available mode, even if there is only one. Choosing Bayer does not silently substitute ProRAW.
RAW Bayer exige uma lente física com zoo: Bayer RAW requires a physical lens at native sensor zoom, without cropping or digital zoom. Selector numbers are relative to the lens system: 0.5×, 1× or 4× may correspond to physical lenses without digital zoom; stops such as 2× or 8× may be crops. Availability depends on the device, not just the displayed number.
Ao usar zoom digital, uma câmera virtual: Using digital zoom, a virtual camera or an unsupported lens turns Bayer off and re-enables processed output. ProRAW remains conditional on lens capabilities and may allow zoom. To return to Bayer, switch to a compatible physical lens without cropping and select Bayer RAW again.
Os dois modos permitem DNG sozinho, par: Both modes allow DNG alone, a HEIF/JPEG pair or HEIF+ development, depending on selected outputs. Photographic Styles affect only the HEIF companion or derivative; the DNG receives no styles.
No par HEIF+, a foto processada vem da r: In an HEIF+ pair, the processed photo comes from custom development and includes your effects. In an HEIF/JPEG pair, processing uses the companion image returned by native capture.
No iOS 27, o app solicita o DNG como ori: On iOS 27, the app requests the DNG as the pair's original. On earlier versions, Photos controls that choice. A badge or display order in another app does not prove which resources were imported.
O DNG preserva a área do sensor; a image: The DNG preserves the sensor area; the processed image follows the chosen aspect ratio.
RAW e HEIF+ usam uma dimensão normal de: RAW and HEIF+ use a normal capture size, approximately 12 MP depending on support, rather than 48 MP RAW Max.
O tamanho varia com a cena, lente e tipo: Size varies with the scene, lens and RAW type; there is no fixed size in MB.
O seletor bloqueia desligar a última saí: The selector blocks turning off the last output. When changing lenses, it keeps the chosen RAW mode and processed photo selection while the new session reports its capabilities. Confirming that the mode is unsupported, switching to the front camera or using digital zoom in Bayer turns RAW off and enables the processed photo.
Live Photo e Retrato exigem RAW desligad: Live Photo and Portrait require RAW to be off. Image Stacking suspends RAW and restores the selection when you leave. HEIF+ pauses during Live Photo, Portrait, stacking or use of a camera without RAW.
As exportações HEIC/JPEG do iOS usam per: iOS HEIC/JPEG exports use a Display P3 ICC profile. Conversion respects the input profile; sensor data in the DNG remains intact. LUTs applied in the WebView work in sRGB, and later conversion to P3 does not recover colors already limited there.
10-bit descreve precisão de cor; não gar: 10-bit describes color precision; it does not guarantee an HDR image. When sharing a pair, confirm which resources the destination app exports and check GPS, authorship and tags.
iOS com RAW/ProRAW disponível na lente a: iOS with RAW/ProRAW available on the active lens
Live Photo, Retrato e Image Stacking des: Live Photo, Portrait and Image Stacking turned off
Espaço para DNG temporário, revelação e: Space for temporary DNG, development and saving
HEIF+ captura um DNG e o revela com CIRA: HEIF+ captures a DNG and develops it with CIRAWFilter. The camera's processed companion image is not the source for this pipeline. The app crops, applies LUT, halation and grain, and exports HEIF.
Escolha HEIF+ em Foto processada no cont: Choose HEIF+ in Processed photo in the TopBar File format control. Adjust development in Settings → Capture and files → HEIF+ Development. If Bayer RAW or ProRAW is also selected, that DNG accompanies the HEIC in the same library item. With RAW set to None, the app uses ProRAW when available, or Bayer as a fallback, only as a temporary development source.
Nitidez, redução de ruído, clareza, equi: Sharpness, noise reduction, clarity, light balance, EV exposure, global curve, shadows, temperature and tint act during file development. They differ from controls that determine sensor exposure before shooting.
Automático da Apple preserva a calibraçã: Apple Automatic preserves per-image calibration. The initial profile uses gentle values for sharpness, noise, clarity and light balance. There is no live RAW preview: compare saved files when evaluating a setting.
Recuperação de altas luzes requer iOS 26: Highlight recovery requires iOS 26 and file support; the module checks each DNG.
RAW 9 é solicitado apenas quando disponí: RAW 9 is requested only when available on iOS 27. If its capabilities are not ready, the pipeline tries an earlier supported decoder.
Ruído cromático, detalhe e moiré não ofe: Chroma noise, detail and moiré do not offer effective adjustments in RAW 9. Displayed support corresponds to the last inspected capture.
O pipeline tenta HEIF de 10-bit em Displ: The pipeline attempts 10-bit HEIF in Display P3 with compression quality 0.8. If the encoder fails, it may try 8-bit, except for file or storage errors. The recipe records effective bit depth. Output is SDR.
A cópia sem efeitos mantém a mesma revel: The copy without effects keeps the same RAW development, without LUT, halation or grain. It is not the DNG or a version without all processing. Grain and detail affect file size.
Até três trabalhos ficam em Application: Up to three jobs are kept in Application Support, excluded from backup. Each stores capture settings, project, location, effects, authorship and date. Development and saving run serially.
O app usa o tempo de background concedid: The app uses background time granted by iOS. When it expires, the job is kept for resumption; completion with the app closed is not guaranteed. On failure, it offers Retry, Later or Discard. Settings also shows pending jobs.
Depois mantém o trabalho para uma tentat: Later keeps the job for a future attempt.
Tentar novamente retoma a operação; chec: Retry resumes the operation; checkpoints reuse already confirmed assets.
Descartar remove o trabalho pendente e s: Discard removes the pending job and its temporary source; choose this only if you do not want to recover it.
Testes nativos com imagens sintéticas ve: Native tests with synthetic images verify export, effects, metadata and recovery. Real Bayer RAW and ProRAW quality, control differences, timing, memory and interruptions still need checking on a physical iPhone. The implementation alone does not prove quality on every lens.
iOS e módulo nativo atualizado: iOS and an updated native module
Apoio ou tripé para sequências longas: Support or tripod for long sequences
Menu Modo de captura com Desligado selec: Capture mode menu with Off selected and Bulb, Motion Blur, Focus Bracketing and Double Exposure options.
O menu de captura reúne os modos de Imag: The capture menu groups Image Stacking and Focus Bracketing modes according to lens support.
Abra Image Stacking na TopBar. O seletor: Open Image Stacking in the TopBar. The current selector offers Bulb, Motion Blur, Double Exposure and Focus Bracketing when the lens reports support. Experimental strategies described in technical notes, such as Night or noise reduction, do not appear in the current selector.
Bulb acumula frames ponderados pelo inte: Bulb accumulates frames weighted by time interval. One shot starts it; another ends it. It requires at least one valid second and stops automatically after five minutes. The stream limits the longest side to 4096 pixels.
Use para observar luz acumulada ao longo: Use it to observe light accumulating over time. Very bright scenes may saturate. Support the device; global registration does not eliminate all movement or parallax.
Motion Blur faz uma média temporal com a: Motion Blur performs a temporal average with global alignment to simulate long exposure without adding brightness like Bulb. Moving elements may blur while stable parts remain more defined.
O resultado depende da duração, estabili: The result depends on duration, stability and scene. The preview is a reference; check the exported composition.
Faça a primeira foto, reenquadre usando: Take the first photo, reframe using its overlay in the preview and shoot again. The mode explicitly waits for the second exposure. The two frames are not aligned: element placement is part of the composition.
As imagens são somadas como luz em espaç: Images are added as light in linear space and receive a curve for SDR output. Default internal compensation of −1.5 EV leaves headroom for highlights. Interface EV affects camera exposure before each shot and is independent of this compensation.
Durante a sequência, orientação, lente e: During the sequence, orientation, lens and other controls are locked; shutter, Cancel and EV remain available.
Captura dupla é outro recurso: gera um r: Dual capture is a different feature: it generates a complementary crop of the capture; Double Exposure combines two shots.
A composição pode receber LUT, grão, hal: The composition can receive LUT, grain, halation, cropping and project organization. The result is exported as HEIF or JPEG.
Salvar original sem efeitos preserva a c: Save original without effects preserves the composition before effects, not the frames used to build it. RAW, Live Photo, Portrait, flash and general manual controls follow mode restrictions. Intermediate files are removed on completion, failure or cancellation.
O alinhamento tenta registrar o moviment: Alignment attempts to register global camera movement; it does not correct all local scene movement. Check for artifacts in water, people and moving objects. Perspective changes and low texture may prevent registration.
Qualidade, cancelamento, pressão de memó: Quality, cancellation, memory pressure, low storage and camera resumption need validation on a physical device.
iOS, Metal e lente física com foco manua: iOS, Metal and a physical lens with manual focus and exposure/white balance locking
Cena parada e aparelho apoiado ou em tri: Static scene and a supported device or tripod
Não disponível em câmeras virtuais, Andr: Not available on virtual cameras, Android or web
Selecione Focus Bracketing em Image Stac: Select Focus Bracketing in Image Stacking.
Arraste os dois seletores da régua Perto: Drag both handles on the Near → Far scale and check each focus in the preview.
Toque nos dois seletores para confirmar: Tap both handles to confirm the limits on the camera. The orange segment indicates the range.
Escolha de 3 a 20 fotos no dial; o padrã: Choose 3 to 20 photos on the dial; the default is 10.
Dispare e mantenha câmera e assunto para: Shoot and keep the camera and subject still throughout the sequence.
A régua é uma posição normalizada da len: The scale is a normalized lens position. It does not measure distance in meters or f/ aperture. Choose limits based on observed sharpness in the nearest and farthest subject planes.
Trocar câmera, lente ou zoom invalida os: Changing camera, lens or zoom invalidates the limits and requires reconfirming them. The chosen count remains for the session. More photos increase work; they do not guarantee better results if there is movement.
A câmera estabiliza e trava exposição e: The camera stabilizes and locks exposure and white balance. The sequence includes both limits and evenly distributes intermediate positions. Each photo waits for focus confirmation; orientation is frozen.
A foto central é a referência. O engine: The center photo is the reference. The engine registers the others, calculates sharper regions and blends them using masks and a five-level Laplacian pyramid in linear space. Cropping uses the valid intersection and may reduce the framing.
Qualquer foto ausente ou sem registro vá: Any missing photo or invalid registration causes the entire sequence to fail; this mode does not deliver a degraded result. The crop must preserve at least 65% of the reference width and height.
A espera pelo foco tem limite de quatro: Focus wait is limited to four seconds; capture to twenty seconds. Cancellation is also checked during these waits. There is no 3D reconstruction or local motion compensation. People, leaves in the wind and unsupported macro photography may cause problems.
Somente a composição vai à fila de efeit: Only the composition goes to the effects and saving queue. The copy without effects is also the composition, without LUT, grain or halation; temporary sources are deleted. Metadata records limits, count and confirmed focus positions.
Ao concluir ou cancelar, o foco volta à: On completion or cancellation, focus returns to the panel position. Turning the mode off returns controls to automatic. Check the next capture and source cleanup when testing interruptions.
iOS, câmera traseira e Scanner ativado n: iOS, rear camera and Scanner enabled in settings
Preview normal, manual ou RAW/ProRAW com: Compatible normal, manual or RAW/ProRAW preview
MiniCPM-V opcional, aproximadamente 1,6: Optional MiniCPM-V, approximately 1.6 GB on the device
Enquadre uma cena ampla e, se quiser, to: Frame a wide scene and, if you wish, tap the subject to guide the next Scan.
Toque em Scan e aguarde a análise de um: Tap Scan and wait for a frame to be analyzed.
Use a moldura para reenquadrar. Ao mantê: Use the frame to recompose. Keeping it aligned provides haptic feedback and zoom adjustment limited by the lens.
Confira o enquadramento e dispare quando: Check the framing and shoot when you want; Scan does not take or save photos by itself.
O Scan identifica um assunto e propõe um: Scan identifies a subject and proposes a crop. Basic analysis uses Vision capabilities on the device. Optional MiniCPM-V helps semantically identify the object and initial region.
Depois, o tracking estabiliza a moldura: Tracking then stabilizes the frame as the camera moves. It does not correct a poor subject choice. The feature does not produce an overall assessment of light, background, lines or photographic balance.
Baixe ou remova o modelo nas configuraçõ: Download or remove the model in intelligence settings. Weights stay on the device; frame analysis is local. Frames, boxes and suggestions are not sent to a server or recorded in the photo.
Sem o modelo pronto, o Scan mantém sua a: Without a ready model, Scan keeps its basic analysis. Smart tags and names are separate options and require the ready model. If intelligent analysis remains unavailable after downloading the model, check for an app update.
Scan não aparece na frontal nem nos prev: Scan does not appear on the front camera or in native Live Photo/Portrait previews. Image Stacking also uses its own preview. During processing, initialization or background use, the button may be unavailable.
Trocas de lente, modo, proporção, orient: Changes to lens, mode, aspect ratio, orientation and manual zoom cancel the analysis/guide. Shooting, navigating or putting the app in the background also cancels it. Low texture, strong movement and parallax may end tracking.
A sessão reserva um único frame, convert: The session reserves a single frame, converts orientation and produces a native reduced copy. JavaScript receives an opaque token; analysis consumes it in a serial queue. The controller moves through capture, analysis, results and return to idle.
Cancelamento invalida a sessão e ignora: Cancellation invalidates the session and ignores old callbacks. Smile detection pauses during Scan. Coordinate and controller tests do not replace measuring latency, FPS, memory and temperature on an iPhone.
Modelo local pronto para tags e nomes in: Local model ready for smart tags and names
iOS 27 e build com SDK compatível para s: iOS 27 and a build with a compatible SDK to sync ratings with the Photos catalog
Em Configurações → Captura e arquivos →: In Settings → Capture and files → Authorship, enter author and copyright. Values stay on the device and apply to future captures; empty fields add no authorship. Changing these options does not change existing photos.
Abra a foto, toque em … e entre no paine: Open the photo, tap … and enter the Actions panel. Choose a rating; the crossed-out star explicitly writes zero. The interface confirms only after writing and displays permission or storage failures.
No iOS 27 com SDK compatível, a transaçã: On iOS 27 with a compatible SDK, the transaction updates the Photos catalog and image XMP. Catalog reading, including zero, respects changes made in Photos. On other platforms, the thumbnail uses the rating read from the image.
Zero significa sem classificação e não e: Zero means unrated and displays no indicator on the thumbnail.
Na grade, toque em Selecionar ou mantenh: In the grid, tap Select or press and hold a thumbnail to apply the same rating to multiple photos. Canceling keeps completed writes; failures and pending items remain selected.
Notas antigas apenas no XMP precisam ser: Old ratings stored only in XMP need to be selected again to enter the catalog; reading does not automatically migrate them.
No iOS, a edição preserva o original. Pa: On iOS, editing preserves the original. For RAW, the rating is stored in the rendered representation and the original DNG is kept.
Ative as opções separadamente nas config: Enable the options separately in intelligence settings. They come turned off and only run with a ready model. Local analysis may suggest keywords and a descriptive name; failures do not prevent capture.
As tags válidas são normalizadas, sem du: Valid tags are normalized without duplicates, with five to eight accepted keywords. The name is sanitized and receives date/time and extension. Suggestions do not guarantee correct identification of people, objects or events.
EXIF registra informações fotográficas,: EXIF records photographic information such as ISO, exposure, lens and GPS. IPTC/XMP records authorship and keywords; xmp:Rating receives a score from 0 to 5. The Komorebi recipe records effects and capture mode information.
JPEG usa segmentos APP13 para IPTC e APP: JPEG uses APP13 segments for IPTC and APP1 for XMP. TIFF/DNG uses IFD0 fields without moving RAW data. HEIF uses ImageIO serialization. Destination apps may read only some fields or remove them on export.
A opção de localização afeta novas captu: The location option affects new captures and requires permission; turning it off does not remove coordinates from older photos. The map uses external OpenStreetMap tiles centered on the photo's location. EXIF Frame opens an external service in a WebView.
Antes de compartilhar, confira o arquivo: Before sharing, check the actual exported file, including location, author, rights and keywords. A name or tag may also reveal scene context.
